title: AI²机器人郭彦东：人形机器人落地，为何先找场景再谈通用？
speaker: Guo Yendong

segments.en: So tell us where we are right now in the evolution of humanoid robotics.
segments.zh: 请谈谈人形机器人目前的发展阶段。

segments.en: There seems to have been a fundraising slowdown, no doubt, after August and June and July's peak.
segments.zh: 在6、7月高峰之后，融资确实有所放缓。

segments.en: Where is the health of the industry right now?
I think this is a great year and a great timing for all the AI robotics companies to start to find more applications,
segments.zh: 我认为今年是AI机器人公司寻找更多应用的好时机，
为机器人找到更多用途。

segments.en: For example, as AS Robotics, we start to find usage of robots in many scenarios, including car plans,
segments.zh: 例如，作为AI²机器人公司，我们开始在汽车工厂等多个场景中寻找机器人用途，

segments.en: including file farmer facilities, display panel companies, as well as transportation hubs, such as airports.
segments.zh: 包括农业设施、显示面板公司以及交通枢纽，如机场。

segments.en: If you stop by the APEC media center this year, you'll find many of our robots called Afavot, Macoffee, Tee, Muke, Muke Tee, and ice cream
segments.zh: 如果你今年到访APEC媒体中心，会看到我们的许多机器人，提供咖啡、茶、冰激凌等，

segments.en: for like 5,000 journalists as a media center.
segments.zh: 为媒体中心约5000名记者服务。
